rationale: As senior in the majority, Justice Thomas is best positioned to assign and keep the opinion narrow on Howlett/Haywood/Felder grounds while rejecting Louisiana’s LHEPA overlay as a substantive rewrite of federal ADA/§504 standards. The dissent is likely to stress vehicle/remedial limits under Title III and Cummings, prompting a modest chance of separate concurrences to emphasize narrowness and remand-only treatment of remedies.
